Syndicate is a locality in the Shire of Douglas, Queensland, Australia. In the , Syndicate had "no people or a very low population".
Geography
The locality is entirely within the Daintree National Park.
The Mossman River rises in the west of the locality and exits to the south-west (Mossman Gorge / Finlayvale).
